text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby reaches its
conclusion with
Адмайр Вега far in the
lead. Мэйсё Дото was no
match for her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Completely exhausted, she's not even
able to
bask in the joy of running such a
renowned race.
She leaves hoping she
can one day learn to smile
and enjoy
these experiences.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
